name: The Washington Globe
ability: Your Political influence counts toward any candidate.
flavor: Francis Blair's Globe, the party organ of the Jackson men: the line came from the White House.

name: The Albany Argus
ability: Each election you win is worth +1 prestige at the end of the game.
flavor: The voice of the Albany Regency, Van Buren's machine. It could elect anyone the party named.

name: The National Intelligencer
ability: You never gain Scandals: when a negative story would give you one, ignore it.
flavor: Gales and Seaton's paper of record, printing the debates of Congress. Too dull to smear.

name: The Journal of Commerce
ability: Your first and second Economic stories each turn give +1 influence each.
flavor: Prices current, ship arrivals and the money market, for the merchants of New York.

name: The New York Herald
ability: Once each turn, you may pay 2 influence to put the top story of the main deck into your hand.
flavor: James Gordon Bennett's Herald: first with the news, by any means, at any cost.

name: The Sun
ability: Once each turn, you may discard a Scandal from your hand to draw three cards.
flavor: Benjamin Day's Sun, a penny a copy: police court, murders, and the moon men.

name: The North Star
ability: Once each turn, if you play two or more Social stories, draw a card.
flavor: Frederick Douglass's weekly from Rochester: "Right is of no sex - Truth is of no color."

name: The Aurora
ability: +1 influence for each different negative story you play.
flavor: Benjamin Franklin Bache's Aurora, which called Washington a tyrant and Adams worse.
